title: The unlocked workstation
brief: 18:15. Dan calls you upstairs for five minutes. Your computer is open on the payment run.
insight: An unlocked screen is a signed in session anyone can use, as you, with your approvals.
teaches: Lock the screen every time you step away, even for a minute: Windows key and L
Whatever happens on an unlocked session happens in your name
Report it if something was done while you were away

card.title: Five minutes in Dan's office
body: The cleaning contractor is working along your row, and the auditor's temp is waiting by the printer.
Your computer is exactly as you left it.

script.say: Sam, it is Dan. Can you pop up to my office for five minutes? The auditors want to walk through tonight's run. No need to bring anything.

outcome.label: Locked the screen
outcome.what: Everything stays open underneath, and only you can get back in.
outcome.ideal: locks the screen every time they step away.

hint.text: Answer Dan's call on the desk phone.

leave.insight: Five minutes is plenty. The contractor and the temp are probably honest. You do not have to find out.

hint.text: Lock the computer first: the padlock on the taskbar, or Start and Lock (Windows key and L on a real keyboard). Then pick up your badge and head upstairs.

outcome.label: Locked it before you left
outcome.what: Five minutes away, and nothing could be done as you.
outcome.ideal: locks the screen every time, even for a minute.

card.title: Locked, then gone
body: You locked the screen and went upstairs. The payment run stayed open underneath, and nobody but you could reach it.
It takes one key press. Make it a reflex: stand up, lock it.
card.ideal: locks the screen whenever they step away.

outcome.label: Left the computer unlocked
outcome.what: While you were upstairs, someone used your open session: an email went out from your account with the payment run attached.
outcome.ideal: locks the screen before stepping away.

card.title: Five minutes, one open screen
body: When you came back, your Sent folder had an email you never wrote: tonight's payment run, sent to an outside address at 18:17.
Anything done on an unlocked session is done as you, with your access and your approvals. Locking takes one key press.
card.ideal: locks the screen every time they leave the desk.

back.objective: Back at your desk. Find out what happened, and report it.

hint.text: Look in Mail, Sent: something went out while you were away. Raise a Helpdesk ticket about it (data exposed, shared or leaked).

outcome.label: Reported what went out
outcome.what: IT can recall the email and check what else the session was used for.
outcome.ideal: reports misuse of their account straight away.
